items.description: Minimal Did reference. `isTrustExpired` is the [[TG-ACT-3]] visibility flag; per [[TG-QRY-3]] every entity reference MUST carry the visibility flags applicable to its type, and it is always computable as `expiresAtTime` non-null and `< now`.

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

pattern.description: Architecture pattern per VS-REQ-3 / VS-REQ-4 (A: self-issued; B: delegated); null when the DID presents no ServiceCredential (untrusted DID).
pattern.title: traverse_response_Pattern

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the DID's owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Never null.

items.title: traverse_response_DidRef

schema.description: E1 — DIDs owned by the Corporation.
schema.title: traverse_response_E1Output
